paragraphs: Konnech sells a software suite called PollChief, built around election management needs. One product in the suite covers election worker assignment, training, communication, and payment, with an online worker portal. A second product covers chain of custody logs, asset and inventory tracking, customizable reporting, and mobile compatibility.

A third product covers ticket management, customizable workflows, detailed analytics, and integration options for a support team. Konnech also describes VoteEdge Technology, which includes a shake-to-vote application for visually impaired voters. The company states that the software is hosted within the United States.
The site names election offices across North America as the users of the suite. The pages describe delivery as cloud-based, with security embedded in design and development.
